evidence_text: Ann Lois Romney -LRB- née Davies ; born April 16 , 1949 -RRB- is the wife of American businessman and politician , Mitt Romney . Ann and Mitt Romney have five sons , born between 1970 and 1981 , and twenty-three grandchildren . The Politician 's Wife is a British television political drama broadcast on Channel 4 in 1995 , written by Paula Milne , and starring Trevor Eve and Juliet Stevenson . From 2003 to 2007 , Romney was First Lady of Massachusetts , while her husband served as Governor . She was raised in Bloomfield Hills , Michigan , and attended the private Kingswood School there , where she dated Mitt Romney .
